diagnosis_arc: Run 1 (FAIL 1/5) was first graded under an ABSENCE diagnosis: '11 .proto files silently unindexed'. That was wrong and is retracted — the probes used to claim it were misread. ax_file holds a content DIGEST, not a filename, so a filename wildcard answers zero by construction (the #1183-era trap); the correct presence probe is ax_path, which returns 79 .proto records. code_files=0 in the terminal line is a labeling gap, not absence.

The second diagnosis — txt-lines chunking splits BM25 mass so fragments cannot outscore whole-document prose — was ALSO wrong, disproven by simulation before any fix was built: a simulated whole-document .proto route ranked the run-1 needle 25th (WORSE than the real chunks' 19th; whole-document length dilution beats fragment mass concentration), and a simulated definition-sectioned route (message/enum/service boundaries) ranked 25/39/23/19 across the four proto queries.

The single variable that moves the needle is the text recall-leg weight. Re-simulated at text^1.0 on the byte-identical index: all four proto needles returned rank 1. Mechanism: the 0.5 default is the #1238 calibration for corpora where the text family carries mirror noise beside code-family body records (the exploit group); otel-proto's PRIMARY content is the text family, so the discount hides the corpus's point. The two corpus shapes are indistinguishable at query time, so the weight is corpus-author knowledge.

Fix: engine #1254 (PR #1258) — corpus.json gains an optional query.text_weight (bounds 0.25..=4.0, out-of-bounds warns loudly and falls back), hub pins carry it through corpus add --from, and the query path applies it to the text^ slot. Zero drift verified on no-hint corpora (cisa, exploit-pocs-2026: byte-identical output old vs new binary).
Run 2 (this grade): PASS 5/5 on the unchanged index with the corpus-declared weight. The corpus flips live carrying the query block in its hub pin.
residual_honesty: The engine fix (PR #1258) must be merged and released before the hub-side query block has anything to honor on a stock binary; until then the pin's block is inert (older clients ignore it silently — the manifest reader keeps it raw). The code_files=0 labeling gap for definition formats remains open as a minor reporting issue on #1254.
